lede: The week's most consequential moment comes Tuesday, August 11, when Telluride Town Council takes up third reading of the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code — a vote that would amend the Land Use Code's historic review standards and landscaping rules to meet state wildfire requirements, the kind of change that ripples out to nearly every property owner in town. Before that, Thursday's Council retreat sets the Town's 2027 priorities, which quietly drives budget and staff decisions all year, and Mountain Village's Design Review Board takes on three multifamily projects. The Telluride Jazz Festival kicks off Friday and runs through the weekend, with the KOTO Duck Race also on tap.

notable.stake: Third-reading vote on Wildfire Resiliency Code changes land-use and landscaping rules.
Council sets 2027 priorities that will shape the full budget and policy cycle.
Three multifamily projects reviewed, including a conditional-use permit decision.
